title: People Walking in Park, 1910s Edwardian Snapshot Black White
description: A candid early 1910s snapshot depicting a young couple and companions dressed in classic Edwardian-era fashion walking down stone steps in a park or public garden. The woman wears a broad-brimmed feathered hat and dark tailored walking suit, while her companion wears a suit and cap. The photo offers a glimpse into casual outdoor social life and fashion trends during the early 20th century.
